gloss: to spark debate; to be controversial; to provoke discussion

definitions.gloss: to spark debate; to be controversial; to provoke discussion
definitions.explanation: To cause or invite debate, discussion, or controversy. Describes a topic, statement, or action that generates differing opinions and public discussion.

examples.japanese: この{法案|ほうあん}は{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}んでいる。
{大臣|だいじん}の{発言|はつげん}が{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}んだ。
AIの{利用|りよう}に{関|かん}する{規制|きせい}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}んでおり、{各国|かっこく}が{対応|たいおう}に{追|お}われている。
examples.english: Regulations on AI use are provoking debate worldwide, and countries are scrambling to respond.

notes:
A set expression using {議論|ぎろん} (debate, discussion) + を + {呼|よ}ぶ (to call, to invite). The verb {呼|よ}ぶ here means "to invite" or "to attract," not "to call someone."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}んでいる: is sparking debate (ongoing)
- {大|おお}きな{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to spark major debate
- {賛否|さんぴ}の{議論|ぎろん}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to spark debate for and against

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {物議|ぶつぎ}を{醸|かも}す: to cause controversy — stronger negative connotation
- {波紋|はもん}を{呼|よ}ぶ: to cause ripples, create waves — implies spreading impact
- {論争|ろんそう}を{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす: to stir up controversy — more confrontational
